bo_replay_meaning: Every member here was scored exhaustively, so the Pareto front is already known and Bayesian optimisation is not needed to find it. The replay answers a different question: if each member cost a fold and a RiboNN pass, how much of the front would qLogNEHVI have recovered inside a budget, against spending that budget at random. That is the regime BO is for, and the regime a real campaign with a larger space would be in.

design_feature_representation.encoding: 1.0 if that window codon is substituted, else 0.0
design_feature_representation.why: The domain is the edit pattern. A summary such as edit count would hide which positions changed, which is the thing being chosen.

folding.settings_source: same as the frozen reference record; span policy provisional

no_claim: Every value here is a PREDICTION from an unvalidated model, on a quantity the planned assay does not measure. No construct in this project has been measured.
The selected panel ILLUSTRATES THE PIPELINE. It is not a recommendation to synthesise or assay anything, and it is not known to beat the reference.
The panel size is a declared placeholder; the assay's capacity is unknown.
No composite score was emitted at any stage.
The base-pair span policy is unresolved. The folding settings were reused from the frozen reference record for comparability, which is a provisional convention, not a resolution.
Every uridine in the real molecules is N1-methylpseudouridine, which neither the folding engine nor the calibration nor RiboNN represents.
The stability side predicts in-solution half-life in buffer; the assay measures in-cell decay by RT-qPCR. They are different quantities.
purpose: End-to-end design workflow on predicted quantities. No experimental measurement of any construct exists in this project.

selection.panel_rule: subset of the given size maximising dominated hypervolume
selection.reference_point_scope: declared from this pool's own minima; comparable WITHIN this run only. No reference point exists on the real scales.

what_must_not_be_claimed: That any predicted half-life or translational-efficiency value is a measurement, is calibrated to the assay, or demonstrates a benefit.
That a selected panel is validated, recommended for synthesis, or known to outperform the reference construct.
That running the workflow resolved the base-pair span policy.
That building the workflow improved the structure evidence, which is unchanged from v5.
That the Stage 2 requirements are satisfied on any basis other than the one v5 recorded, including the two accepted limitations.
That the absence of experimental data is a limitation of the workflow rather than of the evidence: the workflow is unverified, not merely unvalidated.
